text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the technology that allows computers to think and learn like humans. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data without being programmed for every task. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses neural networks to solve complex problems. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. We use it when we ask Siri or Google for information, when streaming services suggest movies, and when social media shows us personalised content. AI also helps doctors find diseases and helps cars drive safely. AI is changing the world quickly.
